# filed-titles

The `TaskTitleGenerator` host service of a host without a model (the browser
composition): `scheduleUpdate` does nothing, so a task keeps the
`synthesiseTitleFallback` title it was filed with — what the desktop shows when
its Haiku call fails. The desktop provides the service from `task-title#machine`;
this plugin is excluded from every desktop app by the composition config's
base-exclusions row (two providers of one service fail boot).

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The task titles of a host without a model: provides the TaskTitleGenerator host service as nothing to do — there is no Claude CLI to ask, so every task keeps the title it was filed with, the same title the desktop keeps when a generation fails (the browser composition, the portable boot test). Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:task-title.generator` "task-title.generator"
  - Uses: `tasks/task-title.TaskTitleGenerator`
